blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 关于长视频的细微问题 问一个动作发生多少次, 以什么顺序发生事件, 回答他们需要找到一个短暂的瞬间 分散在几小时的镜头中 代理模型决定了何时何地寻找希望来找到这些时刻,但这种能力既难以衡量,也难以学习。 分散的佐证证据可以证明,某项行动是在没有确定总数的情况下发生的;核实整个时间范围的索赔要求检查遗漏和重复计算。 仅以回答为主的监督又没有明确监督寻找证据。 我们提出NexSight,它构建了可核查的任务,以评价并培训对长视频的了解。 它的代理管道"SightForge"(SightForge)只有在一个对答案草稿视而不见的核查者能够从原始视频中密集地重新获得的证据中重建出来,反实例检查无法反驳的情况下,才接受一项任务. 这产生了SightLine,从108个长相视频中共出310个可追踪证据的任务,通过SightLoop来评价,这是一个支持时间探索,局部检查,证据整合的多尺度共享工具,在记录返回的观测时进行再探. 在脱节视频中,关于已核实任务的解析器轨迹成为观察决定的分级监督. 最强的模型在SightLine上只达到54.52%,然而在给出附加说明的证据时却达到79.35%. 以6K以下为例,Sight-35B几乎是其基础模型交互精度的两倍(21.29%至42.26%),优于其家族397B模型,在训练后开始使用明确空间检查,其基础模型从未使用,并在两个外部长视频基准上获得8分以上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Long videos record how events unfold over minutes to hours, and many questions about them are fine-grained: how many times an action repeats, which of two distant events came first, or exactly when a state changes. The answers hinge on a few seconds scattered across the timeline, which uniform sampling, spreading a fixed frame budget thinly over hours, easily skips. Agentic long-video understanding instead lets the model decide when to search the timeline, which details to inspect, and how to integrate evidence across observations [ 35 , 30 , 34 , 28 , 29 ] , spending its budget where the question demands. Realizing this promise requires two things that remain open: measuring whether an agent acquires the right evidence and uses it correctly, and teaching it to do so.
blocks.zh: 长时间的视频记录了事件在几分钟到几小时之间是如何展开的,很多关于它们的问题都是细微的:一个动作重复了多少次,两个遥远的事件中哪一个是先来的,或者确切的说,当一个状态发生变化时. 答案取决于分散在时间线上的几秒钟,这些时间线是统一的取样,将固定框架的预算分散在几个小时内,很容易跳过。 代理长视频理解则让模型决定何时搜索时限,检查的细节,以及如何整合跨观测的数据[35,30,34,28,29],将其预算花在问题需要的地方. 实现这一承诺需要两件事保持开放性:衡量代理人是否获得并正确使用正确的证据,并教其这样做。

blocks.en: Measuring requires tasks whose answers are correct and whose evidence suffices for anyone to reconstruct them. Fine-grained tasks make this hard in principle: many are global claims , such as a count or an order, and proving that an action occurred exactly three times requires negative evidence that no occurrence was missed or counted twice. Grounded benchmarks associate answers with supporting frames or intervals [ 33 , 4 ] , but sparse support alone may not suffice to verify timeline-wide claims, and a verifier that sees the draft answer tends to confirm rather than reconstruct it [ 7 ] . With unverified references, errors cannot be attributed to missed evidence, faulty reasoning, or flawed tasks, and agentic evaluations, which mostly score answers or milestones [ 30 , 1 , 36 ] rather than the frames actually decoded [ 15 ] , further entangle acquisition with use.
blocks.zh: 衡量要求有正确答案和证据足以让任何人重建的任务。 精细的任务使这一点在原则上变得困难:许多是全球性的主张,例如一项计数或一项命令,并且证明某项行动确实发生了三次,这就需要否定的证据,即没有错失或计算两次。 依据的基准将答案与支持框架或间隔[33、4]联系起来,但仅凭支持不足可能不足以核实整个时间范围的索赔,而一个看到答案草案的核查者往往会确认而不是重建答案[7]。 在未经核实的参考文献中,错误不能归咎于错失的证据,错误推理,或有缺陷的任务,以及代理评价,这些评价大多得分答案或里程碑[30,1,36],而不是框架实际解码[15],进一步缠绕着使用获取.

blocks.en: Teaching this ability is harder still: agents must decide where to look next, what to zoom into, and when the evidence suffices, yet final-answer supervision does not specify these decisions. Tool access is not enough: the evaluated instruction-tuned 35B model scores lower when allowed to search (28.06%) than when simply given 64 uniform frames (33.23%). Learning these decisions requires tasks that genuinely demand evidence seeking, answers trustworthy enough to supervise, and records of the search itself; few prior works train on their constructed data [ 34 ] (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 教授这种能力更加困难:代理人必须决定下一步应往何处看,如何放大,以及何时证据足够,但最后的回答监督没有具体说明这些决定。 工具访问还不够:被评价的指令调试35B模型在允许搜索时的分数(28.06%)低于仅仅给出64个统一帧(33.23%)时的分数. 了解这些决定需要真正要求寻找证据的任务、足以进行监督的可靠答复以及搜索本身的记录;以前的工作很少对其构建的数据进行培训[34](表1)。

blocks.en: Our key insight is that verification is itself an active-observation problem. Confirming a global claim means returning to the raw video, gathering dense evidence where the claim lives, and searching where counterexamples could hide. These are the same observation decisions we want agents to learn. A pipeline that annotates from a fixed view cannot do this; an agentic one can. The resulting verified tasks serve as both yardstick and training ground: their evidence certifies references and measures what agents observe, and on held-out videos they demand the very evidence seeking we aim to teach.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要见解是,核查本身就是一个积极的观察问题。 确认一项全球索赔意味着返回原始录像,收集大量证据,并寻找可以隐藏的反实例。 这些是我们希望特工们学习的观察决定。 一个从固定角度进行注释的管道不能做到这一点;一个代理人可以这样做。 由此产生的经核实的任务既是衡量标准,又是培训基础:它们的证据证明代理商所观察到的参考资料和衡量标准,在被搁置的录像中,它们要求提供我们所要教授的证据。

blocks.en: We build NexSight on this insight (Figure 1 ). SightForge constructs verifiable tasks for two paths: SightLine supports fine-grained evaluation through SightLoop’s budgeted, multiscale observation interface; separately constructed training tasks provide QA supervision and support solver-trajectory collection. Solvers operate without reference answers or annotated evidence. Their interaction records complement QA supervision for post-training Sight-35B, connecting reliable task construction with both the evaluation and learning of active observation.
blocks.zh: 我们在这个洞察力的基础上建立NexSight(图1). SightForge 为两种路径构建可核查的任务: SightLine支持通过SightLoop的预算,多尺度的观测接口进行精细刻度的评价;单独构建的训练任务提供QA监督,并支持解析器-射程收集. 溶解器的操作没有参考答案或附加说明的证据. 它们的互动记录补充了训练后Sight-35B的QA监督,将可靠的任务构建与积极观察的评价和学习联系起来.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : NexSight overview. (1) Verifiable task construction (SightForge): dense raw-video evidence, answer-hidden verification, and counterexample checks establish reliable tasks. (2) Multiscale active evaluation (SightLine and SightLoop): a 310-task benchmark and interactive harness assess temporal exploration, local inspection, and evidence integration. (3) Agentic post-training (Sight-35B): QA supervision and separately collected solver trajectories improve interactive accuracy by 20.97 percentage points over Base and support Direct-64 transfer to Video-MME Long and LVBench (123-question subset).
blocks.zh: 图1:目视概览。 (1)可验证的任务构建(SightForge):密集的原始视频证据,解答隐藏的核查,以及反实例检查确立了可靠的任务. (2)多尺度主动评价(SightLine and SightLoop):一个310任务基准和交互式利用评估时间探索,局部检查,以及证据整合. (3)代理培训后(Sight-35B):QA监督和单独收集的解析器轨迹比Base提高20.97个百分点的交互精度,并支持Direct-64转录到Video-MME Long和LV Bench(123个问题子集).

blocks.en: Evaluation shows that SightLine is far from solved: the strongest configuration reaches only 54.52%, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence, making acquisition a key bottleneck. At an identical frame budget, agentic window selection doubles temporal evidence recall over fixed windows (19.84% → \rightarrow 40.63%), yet cross-window counting and state change do not improve: finding the right moments is not enough without integrating them.
blocks.zh: 评价显示SightLine远未解决:最强配置仅达到54.52%,然而79.35%在得到附加说明的证据后,使得收购成为关键瓶颈. 在相同的框架预算中,代理窗口选择将时间证据重复到固定窗口上(19.84% ~\rightarrow 40.63%),然而跨窗口计数和状态变化并没有改善:不将它们整合起来,找到正确的时机是不够的。

blocks.en: Training teaches this behavior. Sight-35B raises interactive accuracy from 21.29% to 42.26%, overtaking the instruction-tuned model by 14.19 points and every configuration of the 397B model of its family. Its largest gains come on cross-window counting (+37.50) and state change (+35.19), precisely where better window selection alone did not help, and it begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training (0.72 calls per trajectory), which its base model never uses. The gains transfer: +8.22 points on Video-MME Long (+9.33 on training-disjoint videos) and +8.13 on an LVBench subset.
blocks.zh: 训导此行为. Sight-35B将交互精度从21.29%提高到42.26%,超过指示调制的模型14.19分以及其家族397B模型的每个配置. 其最大的收益来自于跨窗口计数(+37.50)和状态变化(+35.19),正是在更好的窗口选择没有帮助的地方,它开始在训练后使用明确的空间检查(每个轨迹0.72呼叫),其基础模型从未使用过. 收益转让:+8.22分在Video-MME Long上(+9.33分在培训-脱节视频上),+8.13分在一个LV Bench子集上.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) Verifiable task construction. SightForge separates task proposals from acceptance through dense raw-video evidence acquisition, answer-hidden verification, independent review, and counterexample checks, yielding SightLine , a six-capability benchmark with traceable visual evidence (Secs. 3 and 5 ). (2) Observation-level evaluation. SightLoop couples temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting through a shared raw-video interface under explicit budgets. This multiscale harness records observations, answers, and resource use for joint analysis of evidence acquisition and task outcomes (Secs. 4 and 6 ). (3) Learning to seek evidence. We combine QA supervision with step-level examples from solver trajectories collected separately on verified training tasks. The resulting Sight-35B improves interactive performance and transfers to external long-video evaluation sets (Secs. 5.4 and 6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: (1)可验证的任务构建. SightForge通过密集的原始视频证据获取,解答隐藏验证,独立审查,以及反例检查,将任务建议与接受区分开来,得出SightLine,一个带有可追踪视觉证据的六能基准(Sec. 3和5). (2)观察级评价. SightLoop夫妇时间探索,地方检查,证据整合,并在明确预算下通过共享原始视频界面重新审视. 这种多尺度的利用记录了对证据获取和任务结果的联合分析的观测、答案和资源利用(第4和第6节)。 (3)学习求证. 我们把质量保证监督与从已核实的训练任务中分别收集的解答器轨迹的阶梯级实例结合起来。 由此产生的Sight-35B改善了互动性能,并向外部长视频评价集转移(Sec.5.4和6.4)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and LVBench evaluate diverse video content, long-context referring reasoning, and extremely long videos, respectively [ 10 , 31 , 27 ] . EgoSchema emphasizes extended temporal reasoning, HourVideo hour-long perception and reasoning, and MLVU diverse long-video tasks [ 17 , 3 , 40 ] . MVBench and Perception Test provide skill-level evaluation [ 14 , 22 ] , complemented by temporal-detail and cross-time diagnostics [ 16 , 2 , 5 ] . LongVA extends language context to accommodate more video frames [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh: Video-MME,LongVideo Bench,和LV Bench分别评价了不同的视频内容,长文引用推理,以及极其长的视频[10,31,27]. EgoSchema强调延长时间推理,HourVideo小时感知和推理,以及MLVU多样化的长视频任务[17,3,40]. MV Bench和观点 测试提供技能水平评价[14、22],辅之以时间细节和跨时间诊断[16、2、5]。 长 VA扩展语言上下文以容纳更多的视频帧 [38].

blocks.en: Wang et al.'s VideoAgent, VideoTree, and Active Video Perception develop iterative or query-adaptive video observation [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] . Fan et al.'s VideoAgent adds event/object memory [ 8 ] ; T* targets efficient keyframe search [ 35 ] . LongVT couples global previews with native video cropping; VideoSIAH supports evidence-sparse QA and tool-integrated training [ 34 ] . Image-based methods offer complementary mechanisms: V* guides visual search, Visual CoT supplies regional supervision, and VLM-R 3 trains interleaved region selection and reasoning [ 32 , 25 , 13 ] . ReXTime and VideoEspresso construct video-reasoning supervision [ 5 , 11 ] , while Video-R1 and VideoRFT combine supervised reasoning data with reinforcement learning [ 9 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: Wang等人的VideoAgent,VideoTree,以及Active Video Perception开发了迭代或调试的视频观察[28,29,30]. Fan等人的VideoAgent增加了事件/对象内存[8];T*瞄准高效键帧搜索[35]. 长 VT夫妇全球预览,采用本土视频裁剪;VideoSIAH支持证据-sparse QA和工具-集成培训[34]. 基于图像的方法提供了补充机制: V*指导视觉搜索,Visual CoT提供区域监督,VLM-R 3次列车互换区域选择和推理[32,25,13]. ReXTime和VideoEspresso构建视频推理监督[5,11],而Video-R1和VideoRFT将受监督的推理数据与强化学习相结合[9,26].

blocks.en: NExT-GQA and CG-Bench evaluate answer grounding [ 33 , 4 ] , while MINERVA diagnoses intermediate reasoning errors [ 18 ] . LongVidSearch evaluates multi-hop retrieval planning, while VideoGAIA studies tool-augmented video assistance [ 36 , 37 ] . AgentVidBench evaluates multi-hop video reasoning with tool-agnostic evidence milestones [ 1 ] . TRACE / VES-Bench jointly audits decoded-frame coverage and answer correctness for ordering and counting [ 15 ] . NexSight connects verifiable construction, raw-visual interaction, and observation-level evaluation (Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Six Core Capabilities
blocks.zh: 3.2 六种核心能力

blocks.en: SightLine covers six fine-grained capabilities (Figure 2 ). Search scope differs from evidence quantity: a single local window may suffice to verify an answer once found, yet locating it can require extensive temporal exploration. Formal identifiers appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: SightLine覆盖了6种精细磨损的能力(图2 ). 搜索范围不同于证据数量:一旦找到答案,单一的本地窗口可能就足以核实答案,但找到答案可能需要长时间探索。 正式识别资料载于附录B。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Six core capabilities and task distribution of SightLine. The benchmark covers unlocalized fact retrieval without timestamp cues, ordering of separated events, counting across temporal windows without duplication, identity tracking across occlusions and shot changes, state/attribute change recognition, and temporal boundary localization. The donut chart shows the task count and percentage for each capability (310 tasks in total).
blocks.zh: 图2:SightLine的六个核心能力和任务分布. 该基准涵盖没有时间戳提示的未本地化的事实检索、分离事件的排序、不重复地跨时间窗口计数、跨隔离和镜头变化的身份跟踪、状态/属性变化识别以及时间界限本地化。 甜甜圈图显示每项能力的任务数和百分比(共计310项任务)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Scale and Composition
blocks.zh: 3.3 规模和组成

blocks.en: SightLine contains 310 verified tasks from 108 Video-MME Long videos, totaling 74.12 hours across five content domains, with 1,080 annotated evidence artifacts. Figure 2 and Appendix A summarize its composition. Original Video-MME questions serve only source-question deduplication and leakage checks, not candidate generation. Appendix B specifies source grouping.
blocks.zh: SightLine包含从108个Video-MME Long视频中核实的310项任务,在5个内容域中总共耗时74.12小时,有1 080件附加说明的证据文物. 图2和附录A概述其组成。 最初的Video-MME问题只服务于源问题解析和渗漏检查,而不是候选生成. 附 录 B 指定源分组 。

blocks.en: 4 SightLoop: Multiscale Active Observation
blocks.zh: 4 光圈:多尺度主动观测

blocks.en: Task-directed human vision selectively acquires information according to the ongoing task [ 12 ] . Motivated by this principle, SightLoop couples two decisions for long-video reasoning: when to look along the timeline and what to inspect within an observed frame. Its observation loop connects global context, temporal exploration, and local visual inspection with evidence integration.
blocks.zh: 以任务为导向的人类视觉根据正在进行的任务有选择地获得信息[12]. 基于这一原则,SightLoop夫妇为长视频推理作出了两项决定:何时按时间表看,在观察范围内检查什么。 其观测圈将全球背景,时间探索,局部视觉检查与证据整合联系起来.

blocks.en: 4.1 Temporal Exploration and Spatial Inspection
blocks.zh: 4.1 临时探索和空间检查

blocks.en: Global overview. A sparse full-video glance establishes coarse scene and event context. This temporal map guides subsequent exploration.
blocks.zh: 全球概览。 一个零星的全视网膜透视可以确定粗糙的场景和事件背景. 此时间图指导了之后的探索.

blocks.en: Temporal exploration. The video agent selects time windows for closer observation and can request earlier, later, or overlapping intervals. Returned frames expose local events that may be absent or ambiguous in the overview. Frame extraction makes selected visual evidence available for subsequent inspection.
blocks.zh: 临时探索. 视频代理选择时间窗口进行更近的观察,可以要求更早,更晚,或重叠间隔. 返回的帧暴露出局部事件,在概览中可能不存在或模糊不清. 框架提取使选定的视觉证据可供以后检查。

blocks.en: Local Think-with-Image. The general-purpose harness provides an image-reasoning sub-agent that can crop, zoom, highlight, and compare regions from extracted frames. These operations let the agent examine answer-critical details such as identity cues, hand–object interactions, text, or state changes, following the image-assisted reasoning paradigm of DeepEyes [ 39 ] . The video agent selects the frame and inspection question; the image agent selects local operations. The image-reasoning sub-agent uses the same evaluated VLM and returns both transformed images and textual findings. It is invoked on demand, with its model calls, visual inputs, and token usage included in the evaluated system’s resource accounting.
blocks.zh: 本地思潮与偶像. 一般用途的牵引装置提供一种图像推理的子剂,可以收割、放大、突出和比较从提取框中提取的区域。 这些操作让代理商按照DeepEyes[39]的图像辅助推理范式,检查诸如身份提示,手-对象交互,文字,或状态变化等解答-关键细节. 视频代理选择帧和检查问题;图像代理选择本地操作. 图像推理子剂使用相同的评价VLM,并返回变换的图像和文字结果. 该系统是按要求援引的,其模式调用、视觉投入和象征性用途均包括在评价系统的资源核算中。

blocks.en: 4.2 Revisiting and Evidence Integration
blocks.zh: 4.2 复审和证据整合

blocks.en: Temporal exploration and spatial inspection form a revisitable observation loop. The agent uses accumulated observations to update its interpretation, identify missing evidence, and choose another window or visual region. For example, determining whether someone took an object before leaving can involve locating the approach and departure, inspecting the hand and tabletop, and revisiting an earlier view to compare object presence.
blocks.zh: 时间探索和空间检查构成可重审的观测圈。 该代理使用累积观测来更新其解释,识别缺失的证据,并选择另一个窗口或视觉区域. 例如,确定某人在离开之前是否带走了某个物体,可能涉及定位接近和离开,检查手和桌面,重新审视早先的视图以比较物体的存在.

blocks.en: SightLoop records actual observations, decoded timestamps, and resource use. Optional structured memory (Ledger) retains observation summaries across turns. The agent may answer when it judges the evidence sufficient, or the run terminates at its configured budget. Tool availability and budgets are specified per configuration; Sec. 6.2 isolates temporal selection using fixed window deliveries. Appendix B gives execution and failure-handling details.
blocks.zh: SightLoop记录了实际的观测,解码的时间戳,和资源使用. 可选结构内存(Ledger)保留跨转弯的观察摘要. 代理人在判断证据充足时可以回答,或者运行在其配置的预算上终止. 每个配置都指定了工具的可用性和预算; 第6.2节用固定的窗口交付来隔离时间选择. 附录B提供了执行和故障处理的细节。

blocks.zh: 4.3 答复、证据和效率评价

blocks.en: 5 SightForge: Evidence-Verifiable Data Construction
blocks.zh: 页:1 视觉力量:可验证的证据 数据构建

blocks.en: SightForge uses an agentic skill-based workflow to construct reliable tasks through full-video indexing, candidate generation, evidence acquisition, and verification. Figure 3 details how candidate tasks acquire raw-video support and pass independent checks before acceptance. The agent schedules these stages under shared skill protocols, yielding verified benchmark tasks or training data according to source-video membership. Construction is strictly separated from the evaluated VLM’s task-solving process.
blocks.zh: SightForge使用基于代理技能的工作流程,通过全视频索引、候选人生成、证据获取和核查构建可靠任务。 图3详细列出候选任务如何获得原始视频支持,并在接受前通过独立检查. 代理人根据共同技能协议安排这些阶段,根据源视频成员情况提供经核实的基准任务或培训数据。 建筑与被评价的VLM任务解决过程严格分离.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : SightForge: verification before acceptance. The verifier reconstructs an answer from the question and reacquired evidence, without seeing the draft answer or generation reasoning. Comparison, independent review, and counterexample checks gate acceptance; unresolved candidates return for additional evidence or revision, or are rejected. Solver trajectories are collected separately on training tasks.
blocks.zh: 图3:视力:接受前的核查。 核查者从问题中重建一个答案,并重新获得证据,而没有看到答案草稿或一代推理. 比较、独立审查和反例检查门接受情况;未解决的候选人返回寻找补充证据或修改,或被拒绝。 溶解轨迹在训练任务上单独收集.

blocks.en: 5.1 Full-Video Indexing and Randomized Observation
blocks.zh: 5.1 完整录像索引和随机观察

blocks.en: Stratified randomized observations cover the full timeline so that candidate generation does not depend on fixed uniform sampling locations. An observation model extracts visible information from timestamped storyboards; deterministic temporal organization and redundancy compression produce a timeline summary without further free-form model rewriting. The summary guides proposals and search; final evidence is acquired from the raw video.
blocks.zh: 分级随机观测涵盖整个时间范围,以便候选人生成不取决于固定的统一取样地点。 一种观察模型从时间戳的故事板上提取可见信息;确定时间组织和冗余压缩生成一个时间表摘要,而无需进一步的自由格式模型重写. 摘要指导建议和搜索;最后证据从原始视频中获取。

blocks.en: 5.2 Task Generation and Dense Evidence Acquisition
blocks.zh: 5.2 任务生成和深入取证

blocks.en: Candidate generation proposes a question, draft answer, and evidence plan; verification requires returning to the raw video. The agent reacquires dense evidence from target windows and assembles chronological multi-frame Evidence Panels that preserve local changes and temporal order. Evidence acquisition is task-dependent: boundary tasks retain views before and after a transition; counting tasks cover the specified scope and counting units; identity tasks preserve cross-window identity anchors; and text-related tasks check readability across neighboring frames. These requirements guide dense reacquisition and independent review. The plan also identifies potential counterexamples; gaps or conflicts trigger further observations, revisions, or candidate rejection.
blocks.zh: 候选人提出一个问题、答案草案和证据计划;核查需要返回原始视频。 代理人从目标窗口重新获取密集证据,并组装时间顺序不同的多框架证据小组,以维护局部变化和时间顺序. 获取证据取决于任务:边界任务在过渡之前和之后保留视图;计数任务涵盖指定范围和计数单位;身份任务保存跨窗口身份锚地;以及文本相关任务检查跨相邻框架的可读性. 这些要求指导了密集的再采购和独立审查。 该计划还确定了潜在的反实例;差距或冲突引发了进一步的意见、修改或候选人的拒绝。

blocks.en: 5.3 Answer-Hidden Verification and Counterexample Checks
blocks.zh: 5.3 答-隐藏核查和反实例检查

blocks.en: Verification checks Answer Correctness against video facts, Evidence Sufficiency for supporting the answer, and Question Validity : clarity, unambiguity, and answerability. A verifier independently answers from the question and evidence without seeing the draft answer or generation reasoning; its answer is then compared with the draft. Candidates then undergo independent review and counterexample checks.
blocks.zh: 核实检查 回答对视频事实的正确性,支持答案的证据充足性,以及问题有效性 :清晰,不含糊,可回答. 一个核查者从问题和证据中独立地回答问题和证据,而没有看到答案草稿或代代推理;然后将其答案与草案进行比较. 然后对候选人进行独立审查和反例检查。

blocks.en: Independent blind review, conducted by human reviewers or a separately instantiated Codex reviewer, then reconstructs the answer and submits supporting evidence. Counterexample checks inspect adjacent windows and broader task-required ranges; global claims such as counts and first or last occurrences require broader inspection with the search scope recorded. Only candidates passing all three verification dimensions, independent blind review, and counterexample checks enter the task pool for release assembly and validation. Sampling parameters, evidence layouts, and review rules appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 独立盲审,由人类审查员或单独即时编解码员进行,然后重建答案并提交佐证. 反例检查检查邻近的窗口和更广泛的任务要求范围;盘点和第一次或最后一次事件等全球索赔要求用记录的搜索范围进行更广泛的检查。 只有通过所有三个核查维度、独立盲目审查和反实例检查的候选人才能进入任务库进行释放组装和验证。 抽样参数、证据布局和审查规则载于附录B。

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Data Construction
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训数据建设

blocks.en: Our construction protocol separates evaluation and training by original-source ID ( 𝒱 train ∩ 𝒱 test = ∅ \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{train}}\cap\mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{test}}=\varnothing ; Appendix B ). Beyond static QA/evidence supervision, agentic supervision leverages actual solver interactions collected on training tasks. While construction trajectories record how a question is proposed and verified, solver trajectories record how an agent solves the task from scratch without access to the reference answer or annotated evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们的施工协议通过原始源代码(V列车 ∩ V 测试 =\ mathcal{V}_{\ mathrm{train }}\ cap\mathcal{V}_{\ mathrm{ test}}=\varulty;附录B)将评价和训练分开. 除了静态质量保证/证据监督外,代理监督还利用了在培训任务中收集的实际解决者互动。 构造轨迹记录一个问题是如何被提出和验证的,而解题者轨迹记录一个代理人如何从头解决这个任务,而无法获得参考答案或注释证据.

blocks.en: Each retained solver call becomes a step-level training example, with its interaction history as context and the current assistant output as the target. Loss is computed only on the current target turn, whereas historical turns, visual inputs, and tool returns serve as context. Tool-call targets retain recorded assistant text, reasoning, and action arguments, while answer targets retain the solver’s original responses. Step-level conversion filters out malformed calls or execution errors rather than filtering trajectories by final-answer correctness, preserving diverse exploration behaviors.
blocks.zh: 每个保留的解调器调用成为一步级训练的例子,其交互历史为上下文,当前助理输出为目标. 损失只按当前目标转弯计算,而历史转弯、视觉输入和工具返回则作为上下文。 工具调用目标保留了已记录的助理文本,推理,和行动参数,而解答目标保留了解答者的原始回应. 阶梯级转换过滤出错误的呼叫或执行错误,而不是通过最终答案正确来过滤轨迹,保留了多样的探索行为.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: All SightLine results and diagnostics use the same 310-task set. Direct-64 and Direct-128 sample uniform fixed frames. We evaluate two complementary interactive settings: the full multiscale SightLoop harness measures end-to-end agentic performance with configuration-specific interaction budgets and optional structured memory (Ledger On/Off); the matched-budget protocol in Sec. 6.2 isolates temporal window selection. SightLine uses the frozen gpt-6-luna/high semantic rubric; external benchmarks use deterministic scoring. Invalid or missing outputs remain in the full denominator. Appendices B – C specify execution and scoring; Table 12 reports recorded full-harness budget profiles.
blocks.zh: 所有光线结果和诊断都使用相同的310任务集. 直-64和直-128样本统一固定帧. 我们评价两个互补的互动设置:全多尺度的SightLoop控制器测量端到端的代理性能,并配有特定配置的交互预算和可选的结构内存(Ledger On/Off);Sec 6.2中的匹配预算协议隔离了时间窗口选择. SightLine使用冰冻的gpt-6-luna/高语义面额;外部基准使用定型评分. 无效或缺失的产出仍保留在全分母中。 附录B-C具体规定了执行和评分;表12报告记录了全额预算概况。

blocks.en: 6.2 Matched-Budget Active Observation
blocks.zh: 6.2 匹配-预算活动观测

blocks.en: Because the full SightLoop harness dynamically allocates variable tool calls and spatial inspections, we conduct a strictly controlled matched-budget study to isolate the effect of temporal window selection. Using GPT-5.6 Sol/high on all 310 questions, we compare Fixed-Window Interactive (uniformly spaced windows), Random-Window Interactive (three seeds averaged per question), and Agentic Window Selection. Every trajectory receives an identical budget: 32 overview frames followed by six 30-second windows of 16 frames each (128 delivered frame slots across seven logical calls), with spatial zooming disabled so that only temporal window coordinates vary.

blocks.en: 6.5 Capability-Wise Analysis

blocks.en: The capability breakdown (Figure A7 , Appendix F ) shows higher R hit R^{\mathrm{hit}} under Agentic selection across all six capabilities. Accuracy increases for temporal boundary detection (6.00% → \to 36.00%) and unlocalized fact retrieval (34.78% → \to 44.93%). Cross-window counting, event ordering, and identity tracking instead show comparable or lower accuracy than Fixed, suggesting that temporal intersection alone does not guarantee sufficient evidence coverage or correct multi-window integration.

The combined recipe improves cross-time task performance and accompanies greater use of explicit spatial inspection: Sight-35B invokes these tools 0.72 times per recorded trajectory versus 0.00 for Base (Table 11 ).

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: While NexSight advances verifiable evaluation and training for agentic long-video understanding, several limitations remain. First, SightLine focuses on visual evidence and on-screen text across 310 tasks from 108 videos; incorporating audio-visual cross-modal verification and scaling to larger video pools are promising directions for future work. Second, our temporal frame-hit metric ( R hit R^{\mathrm{hit}} ) measures whether decoded frames intersect annotated intervals, which diagnoses temporal localization but does not guarantee that fine-grained spatial details are resolved; combining temporal hit with spatial grounding metrics would further refine trajectory diagnosis. Finally, while our combined QA and trajectory post-training recipe yields substantial gains, future work should isolate the relative contributions of QA supervision and step-level tool imitation under matched training budgets, and investigate whether reinforcement learning provides further gains.
blocks.zh: 虽然NexSight推进了可核查的评价和培训,以了解代理长视频,但仍存在一些局限性。 第一,SightLine侧重于视觉证据和屏幕文本,涉及108个视频的310项任务;纳入视听跨模式核查和向更大的视频库扩展是未来工作的有希望的方向。 其次,我们的时间框架-撞击度量衡(R hit r^{\mathrm{hit}})衡量解码帧是否交叉附加说明的间隔,这诊断了时间定位,但并不能保证精细的空间细节得到解决;将时间打击与空间定位度量度量结合,将进一步完善轨迹诊断. 最后,虽然我们综合的质量保证和轨迹培训后方能产生重大收益,但今后的工作应当将质量保证监督的相对贡献和在相应的培训预算下模仿一步级工具的相对贡献隔离开来,并调查强化学习是否带来进一步收益。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented NexSight for defining, evaluating, and improving fine-grained agentic long-video understanding. SightForge separates candidate generation from raw-video evidence reacquisition, answer-hidden verification, and counterexample checks. SightLine provides 310 verifiable tasks across six capabilities, while SightLoop supports temporal exploration and local inspection under explicit resource accounting. Controlled diagnostics show improved temporal evidence localization, while capability analyses characterize how observation and training gains vary across tasks. Sight-35B, post-trained with combined QA and separately collected solver-trajectory supervision, improves interactive accuracy and external-benchmark scores. Together, checkable task evidence, observation-level evaluation, and targeted supervision provide a foundation for studying and improving active long-video understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了NexSight,用于定义,评估,并改进精细的特效长视频理解. SightForge将候选生成与原始视频证据的重新获取,解答隐藏的验证,以及反例检查区分开来. SightLine提供310项可核查的任务,跨越6种能力,而SightLoop则支持在明确的资源核算下进行时间探索和地方检查. 受控制的诊断表明,时间证据的本地化有所改善,而能力分析则描述观察和培训成果如何因任务而异。 Sight-35B,使用组合QA进行后期训练,并单独收集解析器-弹射监督,提高交互精度和外部基准分数. 可核查的任务证据,观察层评价,定点监督相结合,为研究和提高积极长视频理解提供了基础.

blocks.en: The observation, generator, and verifier stages all use gpt-5.6-sol/xhigh . Full-video indexing samples 72 frames, arranged into six storyboards of 12 frames each, with each frame resized to a width of 320 pixels. Dense evidence is subsequently acquired according to task requirements. blocks.en: Skill protocols specify each stage’s input schema, permitted operations, output schema, and acceptance criteria. Videos are selected by domain and subcategory with frozen source versions. Indexing divides the full timeline into 72 segments, selects one randomly jittered frame per segment using a fixed seed, and arranges them chronologically into six timestamped storyboards of 12 frames each. An observation model records visible people, actions, props, scene changes, and on-screen text for each storyboard. A deterministic program organizes observations by timestamp and compresses redundant information into a timeline summary without free-form model rewriting.
blocks.zh: 技能协议规定了每个阶段的输入方案、允许的操作、输出方案以及接受标准。 视频按域和子类选择,有冻结源版本. 索引将全时段划分为72个段,每段选择一个随机触动的框,使用固定的种子,并按时间顺序将其排列为6倍的每段12帧的故事板. 一个观察模型记录可见的人,动作,道具,场景变化,以及每个故事板的屏幕文本. 一个定型程序通过时间戳来组织观测,并将冗余信息压缩成一个时间表摘要,而无需自由格式模型重写.

blocks.en: Based on the timeline summary, the generator proposes a question, draft answer, task type, structured answer specification, and evidence/retrieval plan. The plan identifies events, time windows, and potential counterexamples to inspect. Evidence organization follows task requirements: boundary questions retain observations before and after a transition; counting questions cover the counting scope and specify units; identity questions retain cross-window identity anchors; and text questions check readability across neighboring frames. The benchmark references 1,080 evidence JPG artifacts. Multi-frame panels preserve local changes and temporal order, enabling reviewers to independently reconstruct answers rather than relying on a single isolated frame.
blocks.zh: 根据时间表摘要,生成者提出一个问题,答案草稿,任务类型,结构化答案规格,以及证据/检索计划. 该计划确定了事件、时间窗口和可能进行检查的反实例。 证据组织遵循任务要求:边界问题保留过渡前后的观察;计数问题涵盖计数范围并指定单位;身份问题保留跨窗口身份锚地;文本问题检查跨相邻框架的可读性. 基准参考了1,080件证据JPG文物。 多帧面板维护局部变化和时间秩序,使审查人员能够独立地重建答案,而不是依赖单一的孤立面板.

blocks.en: Human or independent Codex reviewers reconstruct answers from an answer-hidden review queue and submit supporting evidence, producing judgments of supported, ambiguous, or rejected. Model, Codex, and human reviews are logged separately. Adjacent-window and broader-range checks target missed events, double counting, identity confusion, and shifted boundaries. Global claims such as counts and first or last occurrences require recording the corresponding search scope, combining local evidence support with global counterexample checks.

blocks.en: Source isolation is checked on the video pools and verified on the training records using case-sensitive original-source IDs rather than generated-task IDs. Video-MME numeric IDs are mapped to original video IDs in the selection metadata; LongVILA records are mapped through their source-task manifest. All observations and tasks sharing an original-source ID are assigned to the same source group. The training pool supplies verified QA pairs for static supervision, while agentic supervision collects actual solver interactions on training tasks (question, observation, reasoning, video action, new observation, and final answer). Unlike construction trajectories, solver trajectories operate without access to reference answers or annotated evidence.
blocks.zh: 视频库对源头隔离进行核对,并利用对案件敏感的原始源头ID而不是生成的任务ID对培训记录进行核实。 视频- MME 数字 ID被映射到选择元数据中的原始视频ID; LongVILA记录被映射到其源任务表. 所有共享原源ID的观测和任务都分配给同一源组. 培训池用品核实了用于静态监督的QA对子,而代理监督则收集培训任务(问题、观察、推理、视频动作、新观察和最后答案)的实际解答者互动。 与构造轨迹不同,解析器轨迹的运行没有获得参考答案或注释证据.

blocks.en: Accepted samples pass question-validity, answer-specification, evidence-reconstruction, model blind-verification, independent-review, counterexample, and source-question leakage checks before release assembly. Strict validation covers unique IDs, normalized-question deduplication, video and evidence hashes, timestamp bounds, field validity, and review-record completeness. Release artifacts include the evaluation task file, accepted annotations, a video-selection list, a manifest, and validation records.
blocks.zh: 接受样本通过质询有效性,解答特性,证据重建,模型盲验,独立审查,反例,以及释放组装前源问题渗漏检查. 严格校验范围包括独特的ID,规范化的提问解码,视频和证据散列,时间戳界限,字段有效性,以及复核记录完整性. 发布文物包括评价任务文件,验收说明,视频评选名单,明细表,验证记录.

blocks.en: The resource budget is defined as B = ( T max , F max , P max , K max ) , B=(T_{\max},F_{\max},P_{\max},K_{\max}), (3) constraining interaction turns, actually observed frames, visual pixel resolution, and the input-token limit, respectively. Both the initial overview and subsequent observations count toward the budget; multi-frame panels are charged by their number of source frames. Each interaction logs action parameters, actual returned observations, timestamps, and resource usage, yielding a replayable trajectory. Termination, invalid actions, budget overruns, and technical failures follow a fixed execution protocol. Technical retries cover only transient API failures and never re-run questions based on answer correctness. Accuracy uses the full 310-task denominator, counting invalid or missing answers as incorrect.

blocks.en: Base and Sight-35B use a shared main YAML configuration with the same main prompt and nine-tool interface, Ledger On, max_iterations=100 , a 192k evaluation context, and MEDIA_RESOLUTION_HIGH . The YAML specifies limits of 24 model calls, 60 tool calls, 32 watch_clip calls, one subagent invocation, and 7,200 seconds per task. Actual per-trajectory budget profiles vary across runs and are reported in Table 12 alongside their configuration counts.

blocks.en: Across the 837 retained training trajectories, the root/main-agent requests use deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp with xhigh reasoning. Collection uses the SightLoop interface for Ledger, video overview, clip observation, frame extraction, OCR/visual experts, and an image subagent. Per-trajectory limits are 14 model calls, 36 tool calls, 24 watch_clip calls, one subagent invocation, and 1,800 seconds per trajectory, with a 600-second timeout per LLM request. Model-call counts follow the collection-log definition. Solvers receive neither reference answers nor annotated evidence.

blocks.en: We collect 837 usable solver trajectories on training tasks, yielding 3,315 step-level training examples (2,499 tool-call steps and 816 final-answer steps). We retain valid step-level interactions without filtering by final-answer correctness to preserve search and recovery behaviors. Together with 2,623 Direct QA examples, these form the 5,938-example training dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了837个关于培训任务的可用解答仪轨迹,产生了3 315个分级培训实例(2 499个工具调用步骤和816个最后回答步骤)。 我们保留了有效的阶梯级互动,而不通过最终答案的正确性过滤来保存搜索和恢复行为. 与2,623个直接质量保证实例一起,这些实例构成5,938-实例培训数据集。

blocks.en: Each retained main-agent model call produces one example: interaction history provides context, and only the current assistant output contributes to the training loss. Tool-call targets retain tool names, arguments, and assistant reasoning; answer targets retain the solver’s original output. Step-level filters exclude malformed tool arguments and out-of-budget calls.

blocks.en: Sight-35B is trained on 5,938 examples across 789 original-source video groups: 2,623 Direct QA records from 433 groups and 3,315 trajectory step records from 356 disjoint groups, with zero duplicate lines. blocks.en: Sight-35B is fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base [ 23 ] for 186 steps (2 epochs) using seed 1234, sequence length 262,144, global/micro batch sizes 64/1, AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} decaying to 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} via cosine scheduling (10 warmup steps), and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Tensor/pipeline/expert/context parallel sizes are 8/1/8/2. The language model backbone is trainable while the vision encoder and projector remain frozen, with image resolution bounds of 200,704–3,211,264 pixels.

blocks.en: Figure A7 reports capability-wise accuracy and temporal evidence hit, paired differences, and tolerance sensitivity. Oracle capability results are shown separately in Figure A4 .

blocks.en: The matched-budget study evaluates 1,550 trajectories across all 310 tasks: 310 for Fixed-Window, 3 × 310 3\times 310 for Random-Window (three random seeds), and 310 for Agentic Window Selection. Every trajectory receives 32 overview frames followed by six 16-frame local observations from 30-second windows (128 delivered frame slots across seven logical calls). Multi-turn history re-presentation yields 560 logical image presentations per trajectory. Random-Window results are averaged across the three seeds per question prior to benchmark aggregation. Confidence intervals (95%) are computed via 10,000 paired video-cluster bootstrap resamples over the 108 videos.
blocks.zh: 对应预算研究评价了所有310项任务的1 550个轨迹:310个固定窗口,3×310 3\时随机窗口(3个随机种子),310个代理窗口选择。 每个轨迹都得到32个概览框架,然后从30秒窗口进行6个16帧局部观测(通过7个逻辑呼叫提供了128个帧槽)。 多回合历史重呈现,每个轨迹产生560个逻辑图像演示. 在基准汇总之前,随机窗口结果平均分为每问题三个种子。 信心间隔(95%)通过108个视频的10 000对视频集束靴重新标注计算。

blocks.zh: 附录G 跨基准转移细目

blocks.en: This section supplements Section 6.4 with detailed breakdowns on Video-MME Long (900 questions) and LVBench (123-question subset). Both benchmarks are evaluated under the Direct-64 setting using standard deterministic multiple-choice extraction over the full question denominators. On Video-MME Long, Sight-35B also exhibits substantially higher generation stability than the 35B Base model, producing valid non-empty final responses on 849/900 questions compared to 729/900 for Base (which experiences more frequent generation timeouts and length overruns). In addition to Direct-64, evaluating LVBench (123-question subset) under an interactive OCR-enabled harness yields a +7.32-point improvement for Sight-35B over the Base model (Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 本节补充第6.4节,详细细分了Video-MME Long(900个问题)和LV Bench(123个问题子集). 在直接-64设定下对这两项基准进行评价,采用标准的确定性多选择提取方法,对全部问题分母进行评估。 在Video-MME Long上,Sight-35B也显示出比35B Base模型高得多的生成稳定性,对849/900问题给出了有效的非空性最终答复,而Base的版本为729/900(在生成时超时和超时). 除了Direct-64外,在交互式OCR带动的带下对LV Bench(123个问题子集)进行评价,使Sight-35B比Base模型得到+7.32的改进(表15)。

blocks.en: Appendix H Data, Ethics, and Research Transparency

blocks.en: Data availability. Release materials include annotations, evaluation code, evidence/provenance metadata, manifests, and SHA-256 hashes under applicable licenses. Source videos remain under their original platform and dataset licenses and are not redistributed.
blocks.zh: 数据可用性。 发布材料包括说明、评价代码、证据/证据元数据、清单和SHA-256适用许可证的散列。 原始视频仍保留在原平台和数据集许可证之下,没有重新分配。

blocks.en: Ethics and human verification. Public benchmark videos may depict people or copyrighted material. Annotations follow dataset terms without disclosing sensitive personal information. Human blind reviews and automated model/Codex checks are logged separately.
blocks.zh: 伦理与人性核查. 公共基准视频可以描绘人或版权材料. 说明遵循数据集术语,而不披露敏感的个人信息。 人类盲目评论和自动模型/Codex检查单独登录.
